_notes: Sheet 199 of the tournament savegame (8x4), read card by card from the image on 2026-10-28. CardID = 19900 + idx; 19800 = character card (sheet 198, 1x1). The save's loose cards use key 188 with the same images.
The character card says RANGED, 16 life and MOVE 3: it matches unmatched-memory (attackType range). The 'melee' from the project's memory came from the empty sidekick.

No sidekicks or tokens: Liz's bag in the save only holds the miniature, the life dial (MAX_VALUE 16) and the deck. unmatched-memory has an empty sidekick entry (name '', hasSidekicks false) that is ignored.

Burning cards (burning tag): the 15 with the flame icon next to the title and WITHOUT a boost circle (BOOST 0): Incinerate x1, Fireball x2, Flame Lash x3, Burning Barrier x3, Pyrotechnics x3, Searing Clarity x3. There is no counter or token: it is a property printed on the card.
All the cards carry the LIZ SHERMAN band (none ANY): the fighter restriction changes nothing while Liz has no sidekicks.

Discrepancy: on the real card Fight Or Flight has an ONGOING (+1 to the value of your combat cards; discard it at the start of your next turn) that unmatched-memory does not carry; the sheet's text wins over unmatched-memory (text field per entry).
WILDFIRE's trigger and passive stay as data (liz_wildfire_* effects); the engine does not interpret them until step 8 of the plan and the liz:wildfire plugin (data/heroes/effects/liz-sherman.json).
